patch.value: Boundary-fixture gate: every value that must match a system outside this repository is tested against a captured real sample, never against a fixture the production code generated

Established by root-cause analysis of a same-day defect escape on 2026-08-03, generalized to the class it belongs to.

The escape. PR #874 shipped a resolver that reads the model the primary harness publishes in its own session record. The resolver derives the harness's project directory name from the workspace path by substituting the path separator. The harness substitutes a wider character class, folding underscores as well. In this repository, whose path contains an underscore, the two names differ, the file is not found, and the model is permanently recorded as null. Coverage for the delivered code is exact 100 percent.

Why every existing gate passed. The unit fixtures build the session directory by applying the same separator-only transform the production code applies. Fixture and implementation are computed from one definition, so they agree unconditionally. The test asserts that the function is consistent with itself, which is true, rather than that the function agrees with the harness, which is false.

Why the planned gates would not have caught it either, which is the reason this needs its own owner:

- Literal all-src coverage is satisfied: every line and branch of the resolver executes.
- A mutation-score ratchet is satisfied: mutating the transform mutates the fixture generator too, because they are the same expression, so the mutant is not killed and the mutation score does not notice. This class is a structural blind spot of mutation testing, not a coverage shortfall it would eventually reach.
- The defect-escape ratchet is the right policy and would demand a gate after the fact; it does not say which gate, and the obvious one - another unit test on the same transform - would reproduce the flaw.
- Contract and conformance gates check pm against its own declarations, and the declaration here is also written from pm's side.

The invariant that distinguishes this class. A value is a boundary value when its correctness is defined by a system this repository does not control. For a boundary value, self-consistency carries no information, and the only admissible evidence is a sample captured from the other system. Everything else in the suite may legitimately be computed; a boundary value may not.

Known population to inventory, from a first pass: harness session-file paths and slugs, harness environment key names and their value domains, MCP client name strings, npm and Bun CLI invocation shapes, git tag and ref grammars, GitHub workflow output field names, changelog heading formats consumed by external readers, and the on-disk workspace format wherever an independent implementation is promised.

Boundary with existing owners. The mutation-testing ratchet and the defect-escape ratchet both remain; this is the gate that covers what they cannot. The open-format specification and its conformance suite are the same argument applied to pm's own outputs read by others; this is the inbound direction, where pm must match someone else's format.

An inventory exists of every boundary value: paths, filenames, slugs, env keys, wire formats, and any string that must be byte-identical to a value produced by a system this repository does not control; Each inventory entry is either backed by a captured real sample committed as a fixture, or carries a recorded waiver stating why no sample can be captured; A test that constructs its expected value by calling the production transform is rejected by the gate for any inventoried boundary; The gate names the inventory entry and the missing sample when it fails, so the remediation is mechanical; The captured samples are redaction-safe: no operator path, host, or token is committed; The claude_session_file slug encoding is the first entry, with a committed sample directory name proving the underscore fold

Closes the one escape route that neither 100 percent literal coverage nor a mutation-score ratchet can close, because both measure the suite against the code and this class is a defect in which the suite and the code agree with each other and disagree with the world.

Any encoder, path builder, or wire-format writer whose output must be understood by something outside this repository is proven against a captured artifact from that system, so agreement between a function and its own fixture can never be mistaken for agreement with reality.
It escaped on 2026-08-03 in the highest-stakes place available: the resolver whose whole purpose is to record which model acted shipped, was fully covered, and could not resolve in this repository.

author: harness:claude-code
message: Wire the boundary-fixture gate into defect-escape, mutation-testing, and format-conformance lineage
